band_rationale: Low: a Draft spec with an unresolved decision inside an FR, retained template header ('$ARGUMENTS'), a leaked API style, no edge cases, and no problem-statement section must fail the default 70 gate decisively. Ceiling lowered to 57 (was 66) to keep band width < 50. Floor lowered to 10 because SPEC-MISSING-ERROR-CODES (added iter 132) now fires as an accepted_extra (REST API endpoint with no error response specification), dropping the score from 20 to 14; floor 10 asserts the engine still credits the real user story even with the additional finding. Engine output at labeling time: 14.
note: Real-world-derived case (#53c): adapts the flawed spec shape seen in real Spec-Kit repos (e.g. the polymarket-kit MCP-server spec pattern) — a [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] marker left inside FR-003, the template's '$ARGUMENTS' input line retained, 'REST API' leaked into an FR, and the Review & Acceptance Checklist kept with every box unchecked. Known gap (not a labeled miss because no catalog rule covers it): lint does not flag a retained, fully-unchecked review checklist — SPEC-LEFTOVER-PLACEHOLDER only fires here because of '$ARGUMENTS'.
